concepts.name: 클레이 디오라마
concepts.direction: ART DIRECTION — CLAY DIORAMA: A premium playful stop-motion clay world. Stadium is a freshly sculpted miniature clay diorama in the central existing illustration slot: chunky smooth clay grass strips, rounded low brick houses, cute hand-molded trees, a timber stand and clay goal, soft sun and ambient occlusion. Every icon is a custom sculpted clay miniature with rounded volumes and subtle handworked surface. Sidebar icons are actual colorful small clay objects, not flat line icons. Buttons are low-profile molded clay tabs with soft pressed edges; the four state tiles feel like tactile soft blocks. Warm ivory tabletop-neutral background with muted sage, terracotta, sky blue and butter accents, controlled rich colors. Soft dimensional shadows, restrained clay material surfaces behind text. UI text remains entirely flat crisp sans-serif. Clearly distinguish from flat or painterly art.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, style-transfer.
Input image 1 is the actual current HAERAM football club manager HOME SCREEN, used as the EDIT TARGET and layout reference. Produce ONE polished full-screen desktop game UI concept, landscape 3:2 ratio. Keep its existing layout, content hierarchy and approximate geometry: narrow left navigation sidebar; club name and cash header; season/date/round row; next-match card; thin season progress bar; wide central stadium illustration with stats attached underneath; four team-condition tiles; small footer and bottom playback bar. This is a themed version of THAT HOME SCREEN, not a new landing page. Retain exact readable Korean/English copy from the reference as closely as possible. Club name "Haeram Athletic"; left brand "HAERAM"; labels "클럽 홈", "리그", "컵 대회", "클럽 기록실", "선수단·스태프", "훈련·육성", "구단 운영"; "NEXT MATCH"; "전술·선발 준비"; "시즌 진행률"; stats "리그 순위", "팀 전력", "시즌 전적"; condition labels "피로", "분위기", "감독 입지", "선수단". Preserve simple clean Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif for UI text, clean readable numbers. Do not make body text handwritten, pixelated, decorative or 3D. Fonts are not the main difference.
CRITICAL: Completely REDRAW the stadium illustration and EVERY icon in the specified artistic medium. No reused painterly stadium, no generic Lucide outline icons, no mere primary-color recolor. Use a small 1950 English amateur ground with timber stand, goal, pitch, low brick buildings and trees, rather than a giant modern arena. The sidebar house, league table, trophy, history, people, dumbbell, office building, header hamburger and bell, heart, capacity and playback icons must all visibly belong to the new medium. Buttons, cards, selected navigation, progress bar, textures, borders and shadows must feel part of the same coherent art direction while keeping UI usable. Preserve the recognizable football-management dashboard. No invented features, no extra charts, no surrounding physical room, no browser chrome, no device frame, no watermarks, no external labels or presentation board.

concepts.name: 페이퍼 크래프트
concepts.direction: ART DIRECTION — LAYERED PAPER CRAFT: Entire interface belongs to an elegant handmade cut-paper football world. Stadium is built from layered precision-cut colored cardstock with visible cut edges and shallow cast shadows: overlapping grass strips, folded timber stands, cutout trees, scored brick houses and goal net. All sidebar and toolbar icons are bespoke layered paper silhouettes, slightly offset colored paper pieces rather than line drawings. Panels are cream paper sheets, one subtle taped corner on next-match card; buttons are folded paper tabs; progress bar a narrow inlaid paper strip. Ivory, muted forest green, mustard, rust and dusty blue inks. Tactile paper fiber and die-cut shadows, restrained irregular paper corners. Keep layout clean and information sharp, not a messy scrapbook. UI text remains crisp regular Korean sans-serif. No clay, no photorealism, no painterly rendering.

concepts.name: 1950 매치데이 인쇄
concepts.direction: ART DIRECTION — 1950 MATCHDAY LETTERPRESS: A distinctive vintage football match programme / newspaper print world. Redraw the stadium as a bold two-color woodcut/linocut illustration with strong carved ink shapes, coarse halftone and ink hatching, unmistakably an illustration printed in black and muted vermilion on warm aged newsprint. All icons are custom compact woodcut pictograms / carved rubber-stamp silhouettes with strong legible graphic shapes, not thin stroke icons. Cards have fine letterpress rules and ticket-like trimmed corners; selected navigation feels like a block-printed strip; buttons resemble tiny printed match tickets. Restrained warm newsprint ivory, charcoal ink, faded vermilion and small dull-gold details. Introduce only a restrained slab-serif masthead for Latin HAERAM if needed; keep ALL Korean body labels and numeric data clean modern sans-serif, not ornamental. No page rearrangement, no huge newspaper headline, no fake articles, no random typography.

concepts.name: 전술 칠판
concepts.direction: ART DIRECTION — TACTICIAN'S CHALKBOARD: A coherent tactile football coach's chalkboard game UI. Redraw stadium as a sophisticated white and pastel chalk illustration on deep slate-green board, with convincing dry chalk grain, outlined timber stand and houses, lightly filled grass plane and trees, carefully drawn goal. The view is an illustrated amateur ground, not simply a schematic pitch. EVERY icon is a custom hand-drawn chalk pictogram with confident slightly irregular strokes; tiny controlled tactical-arrow cues can shape progress and selection. Panels use chalk-line frames and very subtle erased board texture; selected nav has a short chalk underline; buttons are outlined chalk boxes; four condition tiles have tidy chalk boundaries. Deep petrol-slate background, warm chalk white, dusty pale yellow and light mint. Critically ALL ordinary UI labels and numbers remain crisp flat Pretendard-like sans-serif, no scratchy handwritten body text. Art and icon stroke provide personality. No neon cyberpunk, no CRT, no pixel art, no wood border around whole page.

concepts.name: 스티커 풋볼 클럽
concepts.direction: ART DIRECTION — FLAT STICKER FOOTBALL CLUB: A bold charming contemporary illustrated sticker universe. Stadium is a new flat vector-style cartoon football ground: thick confident dark contours, simple chunky rounded architecture, stylized fluffy trees, clean flat color blocks, sunny gentle perspective, no painterly brush texture. All icons are bespoke colorful die-cut sticker pictograms with thick ink contour and neat cream/white offset sticker outline: tiny house, trophy, people, dumbbell, office etc; stickers remain functional at navigation size. Selected navigation looks like a neat sticker label; next-match card and state tiles have clean slightly offset graphic ink shadows; buttons feel like simple badge stickers, not generic SaaS controls. Warm cream base, rich grass green, orange-red, cobalt blue and pale yellow, controlled playful palette. UI text stays clean crisp Korean sans-serif. Charming indie sports game, not childish emoji, no collage clutter, no comic speech bubbles, no existing painted sports-comic art.
